batch: Phase G -- party_kind coverage gap: proper-noun content-words whose base has no T4/T5/T7/T8/T9-tagged sibling, so party_kind computes NULL on every live Layer 1 build despite being a deterministically classifiable named person/deity/angel
method_note: Not gloss-keyword matching. Classified via strong_meaning_parsed's first (lowest sort/id) TIP sense row, using STEP's own structural biographical-identity markers: "living at the time of"/"only mentioned at"/"first mentioned at" = an individual person entry; "deity" = divine; "An angel called" = angelic; explicitly excluded "People from/who/descended", "A group", "Ancestors of", "Scribal group", "Combined with", "Name of the [Nth] month", "A location", and etymology-only entries (e.g. Gilead = "rocky region") as non-party. Full tail manually reviewed (51 excluded items), not sampled.
